segments.title: June
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! June is Privates Month, with a side of Out of Office. Half our members are packing for holidays, the other half want results before they go. Either way, a trainer who knows your name is the answer.

segments.title: ₹2.25L
segments.text: So, the number. Our June target for Pop-up is 2.25 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent more than last June. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 3 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 1.24 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 98,800, and everything else 2,200. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 59 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 688 leads, 179 trials, and 59 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.
Here's where the offers come in. Two offers carry 1.02 lakh rupees, which is 46 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: The Second Date's On Us
segments.text: First up, for newcomers, The Second Date's On Us. First class at half price, the second one free, and the third? That's a relationship, with fifteen per cent off the first month and an extra freeze. The plan is 10 buyers at about 5,900, so 58,900 rupees.

segments.title: Don't Ghost Us After the Party
segments.text: And finally, for April's new friends, Don't Ghost Us After the Party. Show up eight times this month, and your next renewal costs less, plus a private on us. Great party. Now the real test. The plan is 6 buyers at about 7,200, so 43,400 rupees.
segments.notes: Members whose plan expires in June.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every offer goes live and the team knows them by heart. Week two, check sell-through every Monday and follow up every trial within a day. Week three, a mid-month check against the target. Week four, count every conversion and brief the monsoon plan for July.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's June at Pop-up. 2.25 lakh rupees, two offers, and 59 buyers to welcome. Members on holiday, memberships on track. Lovely.
